title: Like trainer, like bot? Inheritance of bias in algorithmic content moderation
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It mentioned religion as an example of a protected characteristic where bias could exist, but the actual study focused on gender-based bias in content moderation.
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion, as its case study exclusively focused on gender-based differences in judging offensive content.
